decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be commenced not later than the expiration of one year from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for a restuarant and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class A3  of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 11 a.m to 12 p.m.
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall be confined to sales to customers attending the premises, and shall not extend to the delivery of food or drink to customers by vehicle.

Condition : 6 - Before the development is commenced a soundproofing scheme for protecting the upper residential accommodation from the proposed restaurant use shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and any works which form part of such a scheme shall be completed before any part of the development is first occupied or used. .

Condition : 7 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of appearance and sound attenuation for any necessary machinery has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing and any works which form part of such a scheme shall be completed before any part of the development is first occupied or used.
description: Change of use from doctors'surgery to (A3) Restaurant use.
